title: First Demonstration of Die-embedded Alumina Ribbon Ceramic (ARC) Packaging for 6G Wireless Applications
orgs: Georgia Institute of Technology, School of Electrical and Computer Engineering;Georgia Institute of Technology, 3D Systems Packaging Research Center (PRC);Corning Incorporated;Pennsylvania State University, Department of Electrical Engineering
notes: Process demo: 80+120 um ARC bonded with 5 um GX-92P, fs-laser cavity, TTC-1002 die embedded with GL-102 ABF. No reliability, warpage or RF data on the package; RF numbers only in abstract.

title: Collective die-to-wafer assembly process for optically interconnected System-on-wafer
notes: imec CoD2W dielectric bonding of 7.2 mm, 100 um SiN-waveguide PIC dies onto 300 mm optical interconnect wafer; carrier-adhesion fix raises transfer yield 74% to 96%, 2.4 um m+3s, EVC loss <0.5 dB.

title: High Aspect Ratio (AR) Through Glass Via (TGV) Etch Performance on Glass Core Substrates for High Density 3D Advanced Packaging Applications
notes: YES wet-etch tool for LMCT TGV: lab coupon via growth, 510x515 mm HVM tool (TTV, uniformity, bath control), glass-type etch rates, AR design matrix. Chemistries not named.
